recognize_zh: 這是折線圖而非形態學影像：縱軸為 HTLV-1 抗體效價（cut-off index），橫軸為骨髓移植後月數；效價由移植時約 165 在 5 個月內急降至約 60，之後緩慢下降並在 38 個月時穩定於約 30。
features: Line graph of anti-HTLV-1 antibody titer (cut-off index) versus months after BMT
Steep decline to about 62 at 5 months and about 49 at 7 months
Gradual further decline to about 39 at 17 months, 35 at 26 months, and 32 at 38 months
Titer remains above zero, indicating persistent but reduced antibody response
describe_en: This figure is a line graph of anti-HTLV-1 antibody titer, expressed as cut-off index, in serial samples after allogeneic bone marrow transplantation for adult T-cell leukemia/lymphoma. The titer falls steeply from approximately 165 at transplantation to about 62 at 5 months and 49 at 7 months, then declines slowly to about 32 by 38 months. The biphasic decline suggests marked reduction of the HTLV-1-infected cell burden after BMT with persistent low-level antibody. This is a non-morphologic figure and should be interpreted together with molecular clonality data.
